name: WhereWasTaken
tagline: WhereWasTaken is an AI-powered image geolocation engine that identifies where photos were taken using visual clues instead of GPS metadata
description: WhereWasTaken is an AI-powered image geolocation engine that identifies where photos were taken using visual clues instead of GPS metadata. Upload any image or GeoGuessr screenshot to receive a comprehensive location analysis, including the most likely location, confidence score, interactive map, geographic evidence, and alternative location candidates. Perfect for travelers, investigators, researchers, and GeoGuessr players.
